utilities.note: ~₺4,400: basic utilities $84.54 for 85 m² (smaller for a 1BR, but summer AC) + fibre $15.96

groceries.note: ~₺8,300 home cooking; milk $1.12/L, eggs $2.49/12, chicken $2.28/lb; Kemeraltı and neighbourhood pazar markets

diningOut.note: ~₺8,300: about 10 inexpensive meals ($10.18) + 2 mid-range dinners + cafés ($3.66 cappuccino)

transit.note: ~₺2,200: about 60 boardings at the ₺35 İzmirim Kart full fare (bus/metro/tram/ferry, later boardings within 90 min free); no adult monthly pass. Numbeo monthly figure $43.25

coworking.note: ~₺7,800: Regus coworking access plan from ₺209/day (₺6,219/mo on a 24-month term); open desk at Regus Folkart Towers ₺11,659/mo month-to-month. Independent spaces likely cheaper (not verified)

simData.note: ~₺1,200/mo tourist SIM: Türk Telekom Tourist Welcome 75 GB ₺550/15 days; Turkcell Tourist Welcome Pack ₺1,800/28 days. Foreign phones work unregistered for up to 120 days

accomSeasonality._doc: Editorial: a long-lease city market with summer demand for furnished flats (Jul–Aug foreign-arrival peak, Bostanlı/Urla beach season) and a September student and Fair bump; winter is soft.
